防冲撞姿势

A body position adopted by passengers and crew to minimize injury during an imminent impact or emergency landing, as per operator instructions.

Questions and answers

What is 防冲撞姿势?

In this glossary, 防冲撞姿势 refers to: A body position adopted by passengers and crew to minimize injury during an imminent impact or emergency landing, as per operator instructions.

How is 防冲撞姿势 used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "客舱组员，请指示乘客采取紧急着陆的防冲撞姿势。"

Why does 防冲撞姿势 matter in aviation?

防冲撞姿势 matters because it supports clear communication in Emergencies contexts for Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as ICAO Level 4, ICAO Level 5, ICAO Level 6, and EASA FCL.055.

防冲撞姿势 is mainly used by Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew.

Definition

A body position adopted by passengers and crew to minimize injury during an imminent impact or emergency landing, as per operator instructions.

Operational example

Cabin crew, instruct passengers to assume the brace position for emergency landing.
